## About Us

Our mission is to make **under-collateralized DeFi lending** accessible to everyone — without sacrificing privacy.

We build zero-knowledge proof systems, smart contracts, and developer tools that bridge off-chain credit data with on-chain DeFi. Privacy and financial inclusion are baked into the core of everything we do. We have a vision for a world where your credit score works for you on-chain, without anyone seeing your data. We're building it anyway.
